Never Ending Voat:

I finally implemented the NeverEndingVoat Feature!

There are three options attached to this modules:

  • AutoLoad: if checked, the next page will load when you hit the bottom of the current page. Otherwise, you need to click the "Load more" button.*
  • ExpandSubmissionBlock: this will let the new submissions expand into the empty space reserved for the subverse's sidebar.
  • DisplayDuplicates: if checked, this will insert duplicate submissions with 0.45 opacity. If unchecked, the duplicates will simply not be inserted.

* I forgot to implement it... It will be added with the next update.

Disable Share-a-Link:

I had several people telling me that the Share a link overlay was really annoying. This fix gets rid of this feature.

Set Voat's container's width:

@gnarvin had the good idea to override the default container's width of 1200px and set it to 100% of the available horizontal space.

In the preference manager, you can now set the container's width as a percentage of the total width.

Others:

@crustydouchejuice told me that the empty userTag ([ + ]) wasn't so great, I think he's right. I replaced it with an icon.

I also corrected half a dozen bugs.

And with this AVE is more than 3000 lines of code long!
